Register of Deeds
The County Clerk/Register of Deeds office contains the history record of all real estate transactions in Butler County. If you purchase real estate, the deed and related documents are recorded in this office. If a register of deeds is not elected pursuant to section 32-518, the county clerk shall act as ex officio register of deeds. Butler County has certain real estate records available online. You can obtain data by searching grantor / grantee, legal description or by filing date, and print copies free of charge. Currently there is data and documents available to view or print from January 1, 2009 to the present. The website is: www.nebraskadeedsonline.us
